finding.detail: Preview removes the only explicit Atom instance IS_CONTAINED_BY outgoing permission and says the same fact is not represented as an instance-level IS_CONTAINED_BY Relation. That is broader than prohibiting a second stored Header.Relations entry and conflicts with the preserved formal Relation view in D268 and R2711 LOOKUP. R2588 default-zero whitelist also makes removal of the explicit allowance consequential.
finding.correction: Retain the source-backed logical outgoing Relation permission and bind its sole stored instance representation to Header.Container; prohibit only a duplicate stored Header.Relations entry. Coordinate exact wording with the header/Relation owner, preserving original one-container bound and no automatic inverse grant.

preserved: R2712 retains positive number and active-only uniqueness by immediate Container and value; ::/selector syntax is prospective.
E240 retains active Subject, Scope context and evaluation body; passive dependency changes to Header.Container.
D268/D266 retain direct/inverse boundaries and prohibit duplicate stored containment while preserving non-Atom Carrier rule.
boundary: Preview-only; coordinated Header/Relation adoption, notation and R2511/D264 holds remain separate.
